manaNeeded: {9}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou and exiling the original Capture of Jingzhou with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Capture of Jingzhou copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Capture of Jingzhou and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Capture of Jingzhou and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
